scientific_limitations: Classification is only for the classical fourth-power Franel recurrence with integer initial pair; the explicit local p-adic obstruction is for primes \(p\ge5\) and nonzero initial discrepancy. No claim of integrality classification for other Apéry-like recurrences. Historical priority remains open to missed literature.
source_date_integrity: The day-precise archival source dated 2014-01-05 is the first arXiv posting of arXiv:1401.0854; Franel (1895) and Cusick (1989) are older sources of the recurrence, but their exact initial public calendar days were not verified. The date is the earliest precisely verified public source date used for this finding, not a claim about first historical discovery.
title: Prime-index denominator obstruction and integral rigidity for the fourth-power Franel recurrence
